messages:
maria: Heads up — last night's job produced an aggregation delta in the analytics daily rollup. Suspect same recurring pattern we've seen (partial ETL retries + missing spans). Pls ack and let's schedule remediation items.
ashwin: seen. quick note: span ingestion also had a ~12m lag window starting 02:13 UTC. attaching snippet from logs: 
```
2026-03-22T02:13:04Z WARN consumer: checkpoint missed for partition 7
2026-03-22T02:24:10Z INFO consumer: recovered, resuming
```
leila: ack. looks like the consumer stall caused a join mismatch for user_events -> sessions which makes the aggregator drop ~3% of keys.
tom: @maria can you confirm which customer queries are affected? we should triage severity before backfill.
maria: customer-facing dashboards for billing and feature-flags over last 24h are off by ~2-4%. I've DM'd support to triage top 5 customers, not high-severity for SLAs but needs fix.
oncall-bot: incident-created: "recurring-aggregation-drift" severity: P3. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/agg-drift
sam: quick thought — previous fixes addressed dedupe but not reordering from retry. i can put together a deterministic reorder key + watermark filter to prevent double-skip. estimate: 1 day dev + 4h testing.
nashwin: +1 to deterministic key. also propose a short term mitigation: alert on consumer-lag > 5m and enqueue a targeted reingest for that partition. i can own alert + reingest script.
maria: ok owners: sam -> reordering + code change (ETA 2026-03-25), ashwin -> alert + reingest script (ETA 2026-03-24), leila -> data correctness validation and impacted-customer list (ETA 2026-03-24). tom -> coordinate backfill window and post-fix verification (ETA 2026-03-26).
leila: adding concrete validation steps: 1) run daily rollup on a replay with fixed consumer offsets, 2) diff current vs replay for key hit rate, 3) sanity check on billing totals. i'll publish validation notebook by EOD tomorrow.
sam: implementation note: i'll add a small migration to annotate messages with ingest_sequence if missing — cheap and safe. will add unit tests + integration.
maria: can we also capture recurrence pattern in the postmortem? this is the 3rd similar drift this quarter. want to add an action: recurring-incident RCA + cadence.
nashwin: propose weekly mini-RCA for 4 weeks to see recurrence trends, assign to oncall rotation. i'll create a lightweight doc and calendar invite.
ton: sgtm. also recommend we add a dashboard showing join success rate and shadow rollup delta (0 expected). 1-day SLO: delta < 0.5%.
maria: noted. i've created a tracking checklist in the postmortem doc (https://redwood.internal/postmortems/recurring-agg-2026-03). will update as items close.
oncall-bot: reminder: runbook-checklist: owner assignments recorded.
sam: quick question — do we want to attempt an online patch to reorder in-stream or do full replay backfill? my preference: small online patch first (lower blast radius) + replay if deltas persist.
leila: agree. online patch + short replay for affected intervals (02:00-03:00 UTC). i'll prepare the replay window list once ashwin's reingest script finds affected partitions.
maria: thanks all. action items recap (from thread):
- sam: implement deterministic reorder + ingest_sequence migration (ETA 2026-03-25)
- ashwin: alert on consumer-lag >5m + targeted reingest script (ETA 2026-03-24)
- leila: validation notebook + impacted-customer list (ETA 2026-03-24)
- tom: coordinate backfill and verification plan (ETA 2026-03-26)
- maria: maintain postmortem tracking doc and communicate to support (ongoing)
- ashwin/maria: weekly mini-RCA cadence x4 to monitor recurrence (start 2026-03-26)
please drop any blockers here. :eyes:
